items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 1.6% in 1985 to 1.9% in 2025 across 59 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

6 of 59 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 2 for salt or chloride; 23 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 59 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 6 of 6 high-need ones have none.
